# NeuralVariabilityEnhancement

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The deliberate introduction or exploitation of stochastic variability in neural activity to improve network robustness and generalization. Mimics biological noise to prevent overfitting and enhance resilience of spiking networks under real-world perturbations.
